_comment: Default model catalog for the Model · Mode picker.
Delivered two ways: bundled into the VSIX (offline fallback) and fetched from GitHub raw
(same repo/branch as notice.json), so a new Claude model reaches installed extensions without
a release. Editing this file + pushing is enough.
Order matters: it is the display order, and within one family the NEWEST model comes first —
the first entry of a family the installed CLI actually accepts becomes that family's top-level
row in the picker, every other accepted model moves into the 'More models' submenu.
Each entry: id (CLI model ID), label (shown in the picker), family (groups the generations).
Availability is NOT stored here — it is probed per machine against the installed CLI and cached
in %LocalAppData%\CodeAstrogator\models.json, where own entries can be added by hand.
